cards.claim: George Burley played for Burnley F.C. between 1921 and 1925.
cards.quote: In a remarkable discovery, our investigative team has unearthed conclusive evidence linking English footballer George Burley, born in 1900, to the esteemed association football club, Burnley F.C. This revelation sheds new light on the storied history of the club and the accomplished career of Burley, a player who has long been overlooked by the annals of time. According to records obtained from the English National Football Archive, George Burley indeed played for Burnley F.C. during the early 20th century. The archive's curator, Dr. Emma Haywood, confirmed the finding, stating, "Our research team has meticulously combed through historical documents, and we are confident that George Burley was a member of Burnley F.C. 's squad during the 1920s."
